info.name: Dugout XI - full API
info.description:
The whole backend.

Folders 0 to 7 cover auth, admin, reference data, leagues, the join flow and contest creation. Folders 8 to 13 walk a whole season: pick a winner, lock the contest, declare the result, pay out a one-off contest and settle a league.

Folders 8 to 13 build their own league and their own players, so they can be run on their own; they do need folder 2 to have created the admin, because the dev-tools endpoints are admin only.

Start the backend with app.dev-tools.enabled=true before running folders 9, 10 and 13: they lock a contest on demand instead of waiting for its real start time.
